name: SurgPETL
description: Capitalizing on image-level pre-trained models for various downstream tasks has recently emerged with promising performance. However, the paradigm of "image pre-training followed by video fine-tuning" for high-dimensional video data inevitably poses significant performance bottlenecks. Furthermore, in the medical domain, many surgical video tasks encounter additional challenges posed by the limited availability of video data and the necessity for comprehensive spatial-temporal modeling.
